issues: SAP/P044/Challenge/Part1.lean:69: The joint subject "no-interference and interference definitions" is described as "complementary and equivalent to invariance at fixed own treatment" (continued on line 70). Only no interference is equivalent to that invariance; interference is equivalent to its failure. The formal statement correctly distinguishes them in SAP/P044/Defs/WholeW1.lean:274 and SAP/P044/Defs/WholeW1.lean:275. This is a docstring misdescription, not a defect in the formal statement or the whole decision.

SAP/P044/Defs/WholeW1.lean:260: The same misleading equivalence for both definitions is repeated in the T9WholeStatement docstring (continued on line 261). The correct invariant property belongs to w1OrderedNoInterference, whereas w1OrderedInterference is its negation.
